derivation:
rw [← Complex.ofReal_zpow]
  exact (Complex.cpow_int_mul' (by rw [Complex.arg_ofReal_of_nonneg hq.le]; positivity) (by rw [Complex.arg_ofReal_of_nonneg hq.le]; positivity) z).symm
explanation: `Complex.cpow_int_mul'` relates `x ^ (n * z)` and `(x ^ n) ^ z` when the argument lies in the principal range. Taking `x = (q : ℂ)` and `n = j`, positivity gives `arg x = 0` and hence the required bounds; `Complex.ofReal_zpow` converts the remaining integer power to the real-power cast. The existing proof does not use this declaration.
